description: This file is a core module of the RGraph JavaScript charting library. It initializes global objects, defines utility functions for array manipulation, number formatting, canvas drawing, event handling, and provides background rendering support for various chart types. It includes functions for registry management, canvas clearing, title drawing, scale calculations, grid drawing, and more. The code is modular, supporting different graph types like bar, line, and scatter charts, and handles browser compatibility and UI interactions.
